text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>...
Truly impressive skill. I am deeply in your debt.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...You're right, Meek.
It is frustrating, very much so.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
However... Trainer <username>,
the run from you and your Umamusume truly inspired us!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...I will shine.
...I will, no matter what.
